title: Canon of Heart and Body Joined
summary: A canon for those who join the stream of the heart to the stream of the body until the flesh itself holds the will and cannot be made to yield.

title: Treatise of Heart and Breath Joined
summary: A treatise on weaving the stream of the heart into the stream of the qi so that every breath of power carries the will behind it.

title: The Soul and Heart Union Canon
summary: A canon of the heart stream folded into the soul stream until will and spirit act as one body and one purpose.
